hItems.title: St Kilda
hItems.description: Played at least 1 game for the St Kilda Saints, or currently on their list.

hItems.title: CARLTON
hItems.subtitle: FIRST CAREER GAME
hItems.description: Played their first career game as a member of the Carlton Blues.

hItems.title: 100+ GAMES
hItems.subtitle: SAME CLUB
hItems.description: Played 100 or more games at VFL/AFL level for a single club. Can also have played games for other clubs (including finals).

vItems.title: MULTI-CLUB
vItems.subtitle: PLAYER
vItems.description: Has played a game for two or more AFL/VFL clubs, or moved to a second club during the 2024 trade period.

vItems.title: JACK SILVAGNI
vItems.subtitle: JACK SILVAGNI TEAMMATE
vItems.description: Player has been a teammate of Jack Silvagni.

vItems.title: WOODEN SPOON
vItems.subtitle: WINNER
vItems.description: Has played on a team that finished in last place on the ladder and won the wooden spoon.
